name: vsagentbridge
description: VS Agent Bridge for Claude Code: checks file edits, new files and shell commands under the configured workspace roots with vsagentbridge.exe (TFVC checkout, adding new files to Visual Studio projects, redirect to Output, refusing deletes and renames).

workspaceRoots.title: Workspace roots
workspaceRoots.description: Folders where the bridge works, separated by ';' (for example D:\Projects). Outside them the mod does nothing. Empty: the bridge is off.
